decisions.reason: The complete-package and _24 naming instruction does not change the requested walkthrough or explanation of Master template tables.

Renaming the delivered package files with the _24 suffix does not necessarily alter the required legacy-content migration behavior or its testing semantics; the reference to V14 remains historical context.
Package completeness and file-version naming do not change the required bullet dimensions, alignment, scaling, or approved appearance.
The source decision does not change the required wrapping or page-margin containment behavior for multi-column layouts.
Requesting a complete package named _24 does not change the Master template's role as the foundation for derived templates.
The package-version instruction does not alter numbered-list alignment requirements.
The source decision does not change the requirement that users be able to insert manual line breaks after pasting legacy content.
The _24 suffix applies to delivered template file versions, not to the PBU prefix or Danish naming of styles within those templates.
A complete _24 package does not modify the specified style system or its requirement for consistent application across templates.
The delivery-package naming change does not alter table stability, right-column boundaries, or text-wrapping behavior.
The source decision does not resolve or modify the required Tab-driven list hierarchy or its existing ambiguity.
Package completeness and the _24 filename suffix do not change the supported Word for Windows environment or operational-reliability requirement.
